title: eng-security
text:
eng-security

Maria: Quick favor — can we schedule a short privsec office-hours tomorrow to run through RFC-87 threat model + access review checklist? Need to confirm export/data-flow edges before Friday.
Jason: I can do 10:00–11:00 PT or 2:00–3:00 PT. Which works?
Anika: 2pm PT works better for me. Also please add audit-prep pre-reads (privacy matrix + tokenization notes) — https://redwood.internal/docs/privacy/matrix
Oliver: I can present the threat model diagram and run the walkthrough. Prefer 2pm PT.
Maria: OK locking 2pm PT then. Draft agenda:
```
- 2:00 — 2:05 intro + scope
- 2:05 — 2:25 threat model walkthrough (Oliver)
- 2:25 — 2:40 access review + RBAC gaps (Anika)
- 2:40 — 2:55 audit prep checklist + action items (Jason)
- 2:55 — 3:00 wrap / owners
```
Maria: @anika @jason @oliver please flag anything missing.
Anika: Add a quick section on telemetry/data retention (2:40) — I can cover it.
Jason: I'll bring the access logs sampling plan and a short note on SSO mappings. Can we record? Need to share with compliance.
sec-bot: calendly: Event created — "PrivSec Office Hours: RFC-87 review" on 2026-03-18T14:00-15:00 PT. Invite sent to maria.g, jason, anika, oliver
Oliver: Thanks — I'll upload updated diagram to the event and add a link to the model repo (git+https://git.redwood/repo/rfc-87/tree/diagram)
Maria: Great. Action items:
- Oliver: upload diagrams + run deck
- Anika: prepare telemetry & RBAC notes
- Jason: prepare access sampling + audit pre-reads
Maria: If anyone can't make 2pm, please reply here; otherwise I'll send final invite & pre-reads by EOD. :thumbsup:
Jason: sgtm — FYI I can only stay first 30m but will leave notes in the event
Anika: I might be 5 min late, otherwise good.
Oliver: I'll be there early to check screen share.
Maria: Thanks all — marked owners and will post pre-reads soon.
